definitions.gloss: same age, of the same age
definitions.explanation: Being born in the same year; having the same age as someone else.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}たちは{同|おな}い{年|どし}だ。
{同|おな}い{年|どし}の{友達|ともだち}。
examples.english: A friend of the same age.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}と{彼女|かのじょ}は{同|おな}い{年|どし}らしい。
examples.english: Apparently he and she are the same age.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}い{年|どし}だと{知|し}って{親近感|しんきんかん}がわいた。
examples.english: I felt a sense of closeness when I learned we were the same age.

notes:
{同|おな}い{年|どし} means being the same age.

PRONUNCIATION:
Note the unusual reading おない for {同|おな}い, which only appears in this word.

USAGE:
Commonly used when discovering someone shares your birth year, often creating a sense of connection or equality.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {同|おな}い{年|どし}だ: to be the same age
- {同|おな}い{年|どし}の: of the same age (attributive)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, discovering someone is {同|おな}い{年|どし} often shifts the relationship dynamic, as age-based hierarchies ({先輩|せんぱい}/{後輩|こうはい}) become less relevant.

RELATED:
- {同年代|どうねんだい}: same generation
- {同期|どうき}: same year (school/work entry)
- タメ: same age (casual slang)
